clusters.headline: Listyo Sigit Required To Attend Ethics Trial In Person On Thursday
aiSummaryBullets: Former National Police Chief Listyo Sigit Prabowo is required to attend his ethics trial in person on November 26, 2026.

clusters.headline: Mendagri Tito Karnavian Tekankan Empat Komponen Pertumbuhan Ekonomi
aiSummaryBullets: Minister of Home Affairs Tito Karnavian identified household consumption, government spending, investment, and net exports as four key regional growth drivers.
The ministry aims to strengthen national economic conditions by fostering investment and promoting the export of products from micro, small, and medium enterprises.

clusters.headline: Indonesia And European Union Formalize Landmark IEU-CEPA Trade Deal
aiSummaryBullets: Indonesia and the European Union officially signed the IEU-CEPA trade agreement to expand bilateral market access.
The deal removes import tariffs for various Indonesian products, including agricultural goods, facilitating direct entry into European markets.
